tasks.short: Record medical information and vital signs

steps.what: Verify patient and encounter identity and inspect source medical information and vital signs
outputs: verified source observations and unresolved questions

steps.what: Enter medical information and vital signs into the encounter record
inputs: verified source observations and unresolved questions
outputs: draft encounter entries with source references

steps.what: Compare medical entries with sources, correct discrepancies and release the checked record
inputs: draft encounter entries with source references
verified source observations and unresolved questions
outputs: checked medical information and vital sign record

tasks.design: Configure approved structured observation import into the clinical record {OTHER}. The nurse retains source identification, narrative entry, unit and timestamp checks and final release; no model infers an unmeasured vital sign or missing history.
tasks.previous_blocker: Supported source observations are sometimes retyped into the encounter record.
tasks.enabler_now: Native clinical interfaces can reuse structured measurements if local systems preserve patient identity and provenance.
tasks.still_hard: Distinguish the correct encounter and reading and reconcile conflicts or corrections.
tasks.human_edge: Notice clinically implausible or contextually wrong entries and seek clarification.
tasks.altitude: Less supported re-entry with retained source verification.

reach.learn: Which units and timestamps prevent misinterpretation

evidence.claim: Structured observation import is an E1 local integration proposal; scribe case results do not measure this nurse task.

assumptions: The measuring nurse or assistant produces actual readings and source identity during measurement, outside this recording-only task; unchanged acquisition is excluded from savings.
Import requires patient and encounter identifiers, observation type, value, unit, measured time and source author; missing fields require manual entry.
s1 includes source location and clarification; s2 retains narrative entry and import review, and s3 retains final comparison and correction.
Use current clinical record configuration first; if already connected, no new saving.
This recording scope excludes subsequent report assembly and ongoing monitoring; overlapping task estimates must not be summed.
unknowns: Existing device interfaces and retyping share
research_questions: Can source identity, units and measurement time survive import without extra capture effort?

already_counted.description: Source verification and final checking remain fully counted.
Narrative entry and import review remain counted.

incremental.description: Nurse reports mapping faults and checks changes.
Clinical systems administrator maintains observation interfaces.

approvals.approved_version: Exact corrected patient encounter entries, values, units, times and source references; new source data or edits void approval.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 B=100, R=30+20+30=80; gross 20 less 2 focal upkeep gives net 18. Low covers already integrated observations or manual fallback; no measurement time is saved.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Review the authorised medication order and verify patient and administration prerequisites
outputs: verified administration readiness or unresolved concern

steps.what: Administer medications to patients according to the authorised order and record administration
inputs: verified administration readiness or unresolved concern

steps.what: Monitor patients for reactions or side effects and communicate concerns to the treating clinician

tasks.design: Retain nurse-led verification, administration and monitoring using the existing medication record {OTHER}. Existing medication rules can support the workflow, but no new prescribing, dose selection or automated administration is introduced.
tasks.previous_blocker: Patient-specific readiness and response cannot be replaced by an order or interaction alert.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing medication records and rules support current work without removing physical care.
tasks.still_hard: Resolve uncertain orders and recognise evolving reactions.
tasks.human_edge: Observe the patient and take responsibility for escalation.
tasks.altitude: Preserve reliable administration and attentive monitoring.

reach.task: Clarify orders and respond to reported concerns
reach.learn: Which observations require immediate clinical attention

evidence.claim: G-Standaard supports checks of interactions, contraindications, doses and duplicates; it does not perform nurse administration and monitoring.

assumptions: The authorised practitioner produces the medication order in the existing care process; the nurse verifies it in s1.
Administration status is produced by the nurse in s2, and response observations in s3; all capture and care time remains counted.
An unresolved prerequisite prevents administration rather than being treated as software approval.
No free medication-status feed, new device or upkeep is introduced; this scope overlaps general monitoring and is not additive.
unknowns: Existing medication record and verification practices
research_questions: Where do order ambiguities or missing administration context create extra clarification?

already_counted.description: Verification, administration, recording and monitoring remain fully counted.

incremental.description: No changed medication system or maintenance.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100 and zero incremental work yield zero saving. Existing rule checks do not remove care or observation.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Maintain accurate detailed reports and records

steps.what: Select relevant verified care records and dictate additional report context and unresolved questions
outputs: selected source set and dictated report context

steps.what: Assemble detailed reports and records from selected sources and dictated context
inputs: selected source set and dictated report context

loop.purpose: Draft report narrative without inventing care facts.
loop.input: Selected verified source records and the nurse's captured dictation with report structure.
loop.output: A draft report with source links, unresolved questions and explicit missing sections.
loop.check: Nurse compares chronology, negation, symptoms, actions and unresolved concerns with the original sources; rejects unsupported meaning or omissions.
loop.stop: One draft and at most one correction pass; missing source support, conflicting facts or failed review return the affected section to manual composition.
loop.why_not_simpler: Structured fields use fixed assembly, but converting dictated context into coherent report prose requires bounded language interpretation.

steps.what: Check detailed reports for accuracy and omissions, correct them and release the final version
inputs: selected source set and dictated report context

tasks.design: Configure fixed report sections and a bounded narrative draft inside the approved clinical documentation environment {OTHER}. The nurse supplies the source selection and additional context, verifies meaning against sources and approves the exact final report before record release.
tasks.previous_blocker: Report prose is repeatedly composed from care facts already recorded elsewhere.
tasks.enabler_now: Clinical scribes can draft notes for clinician validation; transfer to nursing report assembly needs local validation rather than assumed case savings.
tasks.still_hard: Ensure a fluent summary does not omit a concern, reverse a negation or imply care that did not occur.
tasks.human_edge: Judge which context matters and confirm the account is accurate.
tasks.altitude: Less report composition with retained responsibility for its meaning.

reach.learn: Which report context is necessary for continuity

evidence.claim: Autoscriber records consultations and supports clinician validation of notes in clinical record workflows.
The Capio study reported lower self-estimated note time and retained editing; its result does not measure this nursing report design.
Source-linked nursing report assembly and its savings are E1 proposals requiring local validation.

assumptions: Nurses and other care staff produce verified source records during care and initial documentation; that unchanged acquisition and recording is outside this report-assembly baseline.
The nurse selects records and captures additional dictated context in s1; all dictation, identity selection and clarification time remains in its unchanged 30 percent share.
Approved report structure is supplied by clinical governance during rollout; recurring upkeep is counted below.
Use approved clinical tooling and native fixed assembly first; no clinical inference, external public chatbot or unsigned write-back.
Local approval, access and patient-information requirements are resolved before use; unavailable source support or unacceptable output returns to manual composition.
This scope excludes initial vital-sign entry and live change monitoring; overlapping broad task estimates must not be summed.
unknowns: Local narrative composition time and review burden
research_questions: Does the draft reduce total report time after dictation, omissions checking, correction and audit?

already_counted.description: Source selection, context capture and final verification remain fully counted.
Draft interpretation review and manual sections remain counted.

incremental.description: Nurse participates in omission audits and update checks.
Clinical documentation owner maintains structures and validates model updates.

approvals.approved_version: Exact corrected source-linked care report including patient, encounter, chronology, actions, negations and unresolved concerns; edits or source changes void approval.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 B=100, R=30+20+30=80; gross 20 less 3 focal audits gives net 17. High requires reusable verified records and acceptable first drafts; low covers manual fallback or checking costs consuming composition savings. Vendor case percentages are not applied.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Monitor, record and report changes in patient condition

steps.what: Monitor symptoms and patient condition and assess changes against the known baseline
Record symptoms and changes and report concerns to the responsible care professional
outputs: recorded condition change and communicated concern

tasks.design: Retain nurse-led monitoring, immediate recording and reporting through existing clinical records and communication channels {OTHER}. No model triages deterioration, delays urgent contact for drafting or infers a change from a newly assumed sensor feed.
tasks.previous_blocker: Meaningful changes depend on direct observation and clinical context.
tasks.enabler_now: Current records and direct communication support the task without new automation.
tasks.still_hard: Recognise subtle deterioration and ensure the right person receives the concern.
tasks.human_edge: Combine patient knowledge, observation and timely communication.
tasks.altitude: Preserve attentive monitoring and accountable reporting.

reach.learn: Which context supports a reliable handoff

evidence.claim: Documentation drafting capability does not establish reduced observation or urgent clinical reporting time.

assumptions: The care team produces the existing baseline during prior care; the nurse checks its relevance during retained monitoring.
The nurse produces symptoms and assessed changes in s1 and captures and communicates them in s2; all capture, clarification and escalation time remains.
No free structured deterioration flag, new sensor feed or automated triage is assumed.
This scope overlaps medication-response monitoring and initial recording; no additive cross-task saving or new upkeep is introduced.
unknowns: Current escalation channels and handoff reliability
research_questions: Where do condition-change handoffs require repeated contact or missing context?

already_counted.description: Observation, assessment, recording and reporting remain fully counted.

incremental.description: No new monitoring system or maintenance.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100 and zero incremental work give zero saving. Physical observation and clinical reporting are retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

reach: Clarify observation mappings with systems staff
